title: The ribosome-associated quality control factor TCF25 imposes K48 specificity on Listerin-mediated ubiquitination of nascent chains by binding and specifically orienting the acceptor ubiquitin
authors: Irina S. Abaeva; Alexander G. Bulakhov; Christopher U. T. Hellen; Tatyana V. Pestova
one_liner_zh: 该文研究核糖体相关质量控制因子TCF25通过结合并定向泛素分子以调控Listerin介导的K48特异性泛素化，虽涉及AlphaFold3建模和蛋白-蛋白/泛素互作，但核心对象为蛋白-泛素而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Polypeptides arising from interrupted translation undergo proteasomal degradation by the ribosome- associated quality control (RQC) pathway. The ASC-1 complex splits stalled ribosomes into 40S subunits and nascent chain-tRNA-associated 60S subunits (60S RNCs). 60S RNCs associate with NEMF that promotes recruitment of the RING-type E3 ubiquitin (Ub) ligase Listerin (Ltn1 in yeast), which ubiquitinates nascent chains. RING-type E3s mediate the transfer of Ub directly from the E2∼Ub conjugate, implying that the specificity of Ub linkage is determined by the given E2. Listerin is most efficient when it is paired with promiscuous Ube2D E2s. We previously found that TCF25 (Rqc1 in yeast) can impose K48- specificity on Listerin paired with Ube2D E2s. To determine the mechanism of TCF25’s action, we combined functional biochemical studies and AlphaFold3 modeling and now report that TCF25 specifically interacts with the RING domain of Listerin and the acceptor ubiquitin (Ub A ) and imposes K48-specificity by orienting Ub A such that its K48 is directly positioned to attack the thioester bond of the Ube2D1∼Ub conjugate. We also found that TCF25 itself undergoes K48-specific ubiquitination by Listerin suggesting a mechanism for the reported upregulation of Rqc1 in the absence of Ltn1 and the observed degradation of TCF25 by the proteasome in vivo .
abstract_zh: 由中断翻译产生的多肽通过核糖体相关质量控制（RQC）途径经历蛋白酶体降解。ASC-1复合物将停滞的核糖体分裂为40S亚基和与新生链tRNA相关的60S亚基（60S RNCs）。60S RNCs与NEMF结合，后者促进RING型E3泛素（Ub）连接酶Listerin（酵母中的Ltn1）的招募，该酶对新生链进行泛素化。RING型E3s介导Ub直接从E2∼Ub缀合物转移，这意味着Ub连接的特异性由给定的E2决定。Listerin在与混杂型Ube2D E2s配对时效率最高。我们先前发现TCF25（酵母中的Rqc1）能对与Ube2D E2s配对的Listerin施加K48特异性。为确定TCF25作用的机制，我们结合了功能性生化研究和AlphaFold3建模，现报告TCF25特异性地与Listerin的RING结构域及受体泛素（Ub A ）相互作用，并通过定向Ub A 使其K48直接定位以攻击Ube2D1∼Ub缀合物的硫酯键来施加K48特异性。我们还发现TCF25本身被Listerin进行K48特异性泛素化，这提示了在缺乏Ltn1时Rqc1上调及体内TCF25被蛋白酶体降解的报道机制。
